task: In Production only, change the traffic split of the multivariate flag "new_checkout_copy" so the "Pay securely" variation gets 80% of users and the rest stay on the control value. Development keeps its current split.
finalText:
FAILED: I could not change the Production split for "new_checkout_copy" because the tools don't expose the ID of its existing multivariate value record. The update needs that ID, and the API rejects the request without it. No changes were made to Production or Development.

What I found:
- Flag `new_checkout_copy` is id 336 in project 87. Production (173) has feature state id 702, which is on the standard (non-v2) versioning path.
- The only multivariate option is "Pay securely" (option id 33), currently at 50%. The control value is "Checkout", which takes the remainder.
- My update setting option 33 to 80% failed with "Multivariate feature state value with this Feature state and Multivariate feature option already exists", so the existing record's ID is required.

To finish, someone needs to supply the multivariate feature state value ID for option 33 on feature state 702, or make the value-ID lookup available to the tools. Then the 80% update can be applied to Production only.
